ValidationRule.description: To check if all the mandatory fields are entered for Corporate Scheme
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_MandatoryCheck_BefActivation_CorpSch__c && RecordType.DeveloperName ='Corporate_Scheme' && (ISPICKVAL(Status ,'Complete – Pending Activation') || ISPICKVAL(Status ,'Active') ) && ( ISNULL(AccountId) || ISNULL(ContactId) || ISNULL(Contract__c) || ISBLANK(Scheme_Cost_Center__c) || ISBLANK(Mailing_Name_1__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Insufficient detail to move the Corporate Scheme to Complete – Pending Activation. Please check if you have entered Account,Contact,Contract,Scheme Cost Center,Mailing Name 1 Details.
